title: Risk Assessment: Supervision Layer Second Pass — Duplicate Implementation Risk
summary: Risk assessment for the plan proposing three supervision-layer fixes: (1) agent livelock/repetition-loop detection, (2) two-hour timeout visibility, (3) false convergence-stall suppression. The plan's design is correct, but commit 6ffe97c8e on the issue-3665-supervision-gaps branch already implements all three areas (17 files, 1072 insertions). None of these changes are in the current working tree. The primary risk is duplicate implementation — implementers rebuilding 1072 lines of code that already exist. Verdict: PROCEED_WITH_INTEGRATION. The plan should be revised to integrate the fix commit rather than reimplement, and the 3 open HITL decisions (cq-1, cq-2, cq-3) should be resolved before implementation.
scope_basis: The plan proposes three areas of work that map exactly to commit 6ffe97c8e. The fix commit chose: (1) parse existing Claude Code log format for livelock detection, (2) pipeline-level agent_timeout_seconds config (no per-role overrides), (3) nudge agent as livelock recovery (requires_adjudication=False). These match the plan's defaults for cq-1, cq-2, cq-3. If the operator chooses different options, the already-implemented code will need modification.

risks.title: Duplicate implementation of already-completed work
risks.detail: Commit 6ffe97c8e on the issue-3665-supervision-gaps branch implements all three plan areas: livelock detection (loop_detection.py, 317 lines), timeout visibility (agent_timeout_seconds config, SIGTERM classification, env var wiring), and convergence-stall suppression (get_agent_activity_ages, _has_recent_agent_activity, snapshot enrichment). The plan proposes building these from scratch. If the plan proceeds without integrating the fix commit, implementers will rebuild 1072 lines of code that already exist.
mitigations: Revise the plan to add a task for integrating commit 6ffe97c8e from the issue-3665-supervision-gaps branch
Change task descriptions from CREATE to VERIFY/INTEGRATE for items already implemented
Verify the fix commit's design matches the plan before integration
Run the existing tests (test_loop_detection.py, test_timeout_sigterm.py, test_convergence_stall_suppression.py, test_agent_timeout_config.py) after integration

risks.title: HITL decisions may require modifications to already-implemented code
risks.detail: Three decisions are open (cq-1, cq-2, cq-3). The fix commit made default choices: parse existing logs (cq-1), pipeline-level config (cq-2), nudge agent (cq-3). If the operator chooses different options (e.g., structured tool-call emitter, per-role timeouts, or respawn instead of nudge), the already-implemented code will need modification.
mitigations: Resolve HITL decisions before integration so the correct implementation path is clear
If operator chooses different options, modify the integrated code rather than reimplementing
Document which fix-commit choices align with each HITL decision

risks.title: Branch integration complexity
risks.detail: The fix commit is on the issue-3665-supervision-gaps branch, which diverged from the current work branch. Integration may require conflict resolution, especially in files like detection_plane.py and _loop.py that are touched by both branches.
mitigations: Perform a dry-run merge to identify conflicts before integration
Verify that the fix commit's changes are compatible with the current branch's state
Run the full test suite after integration to catch regressions

risks.title: Test naming discrepancy
risks.detail: The plan proposes test_event_loop_legitimate_outcome.py but the fix commit has test_timeout_sigterm.py. Both cover the same exit-143 classification. No functional gap, just naming difference.
mitigations: Use the fix commit's test files as-is after integration
No action needed — naming difference has no functional impact
